## Profile

I am a business intelligence and data analyst with a strong interest in turning raw operational data into clear performance metrics, dashboards, and decision-ready reporting.

My work sits at the intersection of business questions and analytical execution. I enjoy designing KPI frameworks, exploring performance drivers, and building lightweight data products that make trends easier to understand for non-technical audiences.

The structure of this website reflects that same goal. The homepage introduces my professional story, the experience page shows how I have applied analytics in work and coursework, and the project pages go deeper into methods such as experimentation, dashboard design, econometrics, and interactive reporting.

## What I Like Working On

- KPI and business performance analysis
- Dashboard design for decision support
- SQL and Python workflows for repeatable reporting
- Translating technical results into simple business language
